args.body:
Dear Contoso Ltd,

Thank you for bringing this to our attention. We’ve corrected the discrepancy in your billing records:

- **Your plan tier has been updated to PLATINUM-QSKB**, in line with your contract.
- A refund of **$175** has been processed and will reflect in your account within 1-2 business days.

If you notice further issues, reply to this email or open a new ticket. We appreciate your patience.

Best regards,
The IT Operations Team
